key_insight: Combining CFD-guided wear-zone identification with coating characterization and abrasion testing supports selection of wear-resistant coatings for ventilation mill components.
engineering_relevance: Targeted coatings could extend component service life in hot, abrasive flows with sand concentrations reaching up to 40%.
method: Use CFD to identify critical wear zones.
Evaluate manual metal arc welding, HVOF spraying, and plasma welding with varied filler compositions.
Characterize coatings using SEM-EDS, cross-sectional hardness measurements, and controlled sandblasting tests.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports microstructural, compositional, hardness, and simulated-abrasion evaluations, but provides no numerical wear reductions or coating rankings.
watch_item: Service-life gains require validation under actual mill operating conditions beyond controlled sandblasting tests.
paper_title: Analysis of Wear-Resistant Coating Technologies for Extending the Service Life of Ventilation Mill Components
